column2: Who do you think you are!?
No ordinary person can even approach this place. To pass through the Lost Forest and reach the Kuryu Valley...
The Kuryu Valley?
Don't play dumb! You're Sanada's people, aren't you!?
H-hold on a second! You've got it wrong!
Y-yeah, that's right!
Anyway, who are YOU?
Before you ask someone's name, give your own!
I'm {p}.
Seiji Hayami.
I'm Honey Kisaragi.
I'll tell you, as a souvenir for your trip to the afterlife.\n\nI am Miroku Mugen, son of Taigen Mugen, lord of Kuryu Castle!
Take this! Kuryu Haken: Voidbreak!
Whoaaa!
Gyaaah!
Whoa!? You weren't aiming at us?
Of course not.\n\nThe way you're dressed stands out way too much. No way that's a ninja's outfit!
The guys you just beat look like ninja, though...?
Sanada ninja, most likely...
Sanada ninja...? This isn't some samurai drama...
Samurai drama...? What's that? Where did you people come from, anyway?
Actually...
A strange tale...\n\nMaybe we'd better consult the great lord. But whether he'll... Hmm...
What's wrong, Miroku-san?
Duh-heh-heh... Ooh, a purty lady!
This is Guzumushi the Crybaby of the Kuryu clan! Guzumushi! It seems Sanada ninja have started sneaking in. Warn everyone!
Okaaay... But first, they want you back at the castle... The great lord has... woken up...
My father has? Understood, I'll return to the castle at once. You lot come too.
At this point, we've got no choice but to go along.
It's like we time-slipped back to the end of the Warring States era.
Wandering around aimlessly would be more dangerous.
...Crossed through time... The walls grow lower, little by little...
*Snrk*... *snff*... Welcome, welcome. {p}... *snrk*... Honey Kisaragi... *snff*... Seiji Hayami!
I've heard about you from... *snrk*... Miroku... *snff*. Miroku, you... *sniff*... go with {p} and the others... *snff*!
What are you saying, Father!?
{p} and the others' tale... is an omen of danger to us... *snrk*! The Lost Forest has been breached, and Sanada ninja have begun to appear... *snff*! There's no greater proof... *sniff*!
An omen of danger...?
We have a duty to protect the land of the rising sun... *snrk*! Without ever stepping onto history's main stage... *snff*!
Father, you think {p} and the others' tale is connected to the Lost Forest being breached?
Exactly... *snrk-snff*!
If that's how it is, I've no objection! I'll go, to protect the valley!
Well spoken! ...*sniff-snrk*!! Is Kokushimaru here!?
Here!
Assist Miroku along with Guzumushi! ...*snrk*!
Yes, my lord!
Now go, Miroku! ...*snff*!
It's the great lord's order, but I don't trust you yet. Let's see what you can do.
And what's that supposed to mean?
Show me you can get through the Lost Forest!\n\nThen I'll accept you.
Buuut... there's Sanada ninja out there...?
That's exactly why we'll learn their true strength and nature.
I seeee!
Hey, hey, is the Kuryu Valley up ahead, I wonder?
Who are you? What business do you have in the Kuryu Valley?
I'm called Isa Nyudo. Oh my, you're just my type, sonny! So cute I could eat you up!
Don't mess with me! Unless you state your business, you're not getting past!
If I tell you, you'll let me through?\n\nI want the great lord's head!
You're one of Sanada's!?
GUEEEH!
Whoa!
Kyaa!
Wh-what is this!?
Sanada sorcery: Rotting Thread Snare!\n\nAnyone caught in it gets absorbed into this slime, every last one!
I can't move!
Ohohoho...! You'll feel all better soon!
Miroku-san!
You saved us...!
He cut through space and sent it flying...!?
Don't get cocky, Sanada ninja! You're not getting one step past here! Prepare yourself!
You think you can beat me? You've got some nerve... Prepare yourselves!
Forgive my rudeness till now. The great lord was right about you after all. I'll entrust the fate of this journey to you.
The other monk... are you a Sanada ninja too!?
Indeed! Rokuro Unno of the Ten Sanada Braves!! Every picture I draw becomes real! Sanada sorcery: Demon Scroll!!
The Slum King's threat is gone, but something's wrong in the mountains to the northwest... They call it the Lost Forest now, and they say if you go in, you don't come back alive.
What an impressive wall.
Still, isn't it way too big?
Bet some rich guy lives here. Heh heh heh!
Hey, hey, don't go getting any crooked ideas!
Let's find the entrance and go in!
Nothing but sand as far as the eye can see...
A sandstorm's blowing...!
Isn't this desert bigger than the building's grounds?
I've got sand even in my ears...
It's like the African savanna in here...
Think there's lions and elephants?
Oh, Mondo, you wanna go hunting in a place like this?
Always wanted to try it once!
But isn't this place way too big?
I really soaked up the great outdoors!
Brrr... It's so cold!
Even my breath feels like it's going to freeze...
Ugh... Honey, warm me up...
This is no time for jokes, Seiji-kun!
I'm not joking...
How come? This ice field seems bigger than the building's grounds...
I was al-most fro-zen so-lid...!
